sources.title: Frozen Differential Scattering in Reconfigurable Complex Media
sources.author: Philipp del Hougne
sources.supports: Exact finite local-load differential rank-one factorization; reciprocity unnecessary; multi-perturber rank; toggled matched filtering and noise-aware shaping
sources.limitation: Source results credited. This lane did not independently audit the experiment or every proof. An attempted direct arXiv HTML open failed.

sources.title: Virtual VNA: Minimal-Ambiguity Scattering Matrix Estimation With a Fixed Set of Virtual Load-Tunable Ports
sources.author: Philipp del Hougne
sources.inspected: IEEE primary abstract and author arXiv abstract page
sources.supports: Three known load states; hidden-port reconstruction; sign ambiguity; calibration count
sources.limitation: Methods and apparatus details beyond the abstract were not independently audited.

sources.title: Virtual VNA 3.0: Unambiguous Scattering Matrix Estimation for Non-Reciprocal Systems by Leveraging Tunable and Coupled Loads
sources.author: Philipp del Hougne
sources.supports: Tunable and coupled hidden loads remove ambiguity for nonreciprocal scattering-matrix estimation
sources.limitation: Only the abstract-level interface was used; no claim of new nonreciprocity escape is made.

sources.title: In-situ physical adjoint computing in multiple-scattering electromagnetic environments for wave control
sources.authors: John Guillamon, Cheng-Zhen Wang, Zin Lin, Tsampikos Kottos
sources.inspected: Primary full text: abstract, principles, local sensing/actuation conditions and experimental implementation
sources.supports: Two forward/adjoint propagations with local field measurement and actuator derivatives; physical native gradient operation; target transfer, absorption and camouflage demonstrations
sources.limitation: Published apparatus evidence belongs to the source authors; it is not a campaign laboratory result.

sources.title: Spectral phase transitions in optical parametric oscillators
sources.authors: Arkadev Roy, Saman Jahani, Carsten Langrock, Martin Fejer, Alireza Marandi
sources.inspected: Primary full text: linear growth eigenvalues, threshold analysis, experimental characterization, critical slowing and discussion
sources.supports: Established physical threshold/mode selection competitor; source-reported spectroscopy experiments
sources.limitation: Not the exact symmetric Ornstein-Uhlenbeck contract in this report; no end-to-end superiority comparison was performed.

sources.title: Control Theory and Experimental Design in Diffusion Processes
sources.authors: Giles Hooker, Kevin K. Lin, Bruce Rogers
sources.inspected: Primary full text v2/v3: section 2 likelihood/Fisher-information control formulation and section 4 double-well bounded-control example; current v3 PDF text also inspected
sources.supports: Close established active-experimental-design comparator; feedback maximization of path Fisher information and double-well particle example
sources.limitation: Its example uses a quartic plus Gaussian barrier; no claim that this is the exact uniform opposite-curvature result or that the absence of that result establishes priority. Source numerical simulations were not replayed.
